subject.name: Biology
subject.examPattern: Extended: Paper 2 MCQ 45 min, 40 questions + Paper 4 Theory 1 h 15, 80 marks (~6–8 structured) + Paper 6 ATP 1 h, 40 marks (or P5 Practical). Weights 30/50/20. Grades A*–G.

items.name: Respiration and Gas Exchange in Humans

subtopics.name: Aerobic respiration: uses of energy and word and balanced equations
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Enzymes and temperature (IGCSE ch 5); photosynthesis equation as the reverse (IGCSE ch 6)

subtopics.name: Anaerobic respiration in muscles and yeast; oxygen debt and lactic acid
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Aerobic respiration; fermentation in bread and ethanol making

subtopics.name: Gas exchange surfaces and structure of the breathing system
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Diffusion and surface area (IGCSE ch 3); lung structure (Lower Secondary Stage 8)

subtopics.name: Mechanism of ventilation: intercostal muscles, diaphragm and the effect of physical activity on breathing
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Breathing system structure; volume and pressure in the thorax; lactic acid build-up

subtopics.name: Nervous system: neurones, reflex arcs and synapses
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Specialised cells and organ systems (IGCSE ch 2)

subtopics.name: Sense organs: structure and function of the eye, accommodation and pupil reflex
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Reflex arcs; lenses focusing light (physics)

subtopics.name: Hormones in humans: endocrine glands and adrenaline; comparing nervous and hormonal control
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Nervous system; transport of substances in blood plasma

subtopics.name: Tropic responses in plants: gravitropism, phototropism and auxin
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Plant growth needs light for photosynthesis (IGCSE ch 6)

subtopics.name: Excretion: kidney structure, nephron, ultrafiltration and selective reabsorption
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Active transport (IGCSE ch 3); amino acids absorbed after digestion (IGCSE ch 7)

subtopics.name: Deamination in the liver and formation of urea
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Kidney structure; proteins made of amino acids (IGCSE ch 4)

subtopics.name: Homeostasis and negative feedback: control of blood glucose by insulin and glucagon; type 1 diabetes
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Hormones and endocrine glands; Coordination and Response

subtopics.name: Control of body temperature: skin, sweating, vasodilation and vasoconstriction
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Negative feedback; blood vessels (IGCSE ch 9)

subtopics.name: Asexual and sexual reproduction: advantages and disadvantages
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Plant and animal life cycles (Lower Secondary Science Stage 8)

subtopics.name: Flower structure; insect- and wind-pollination
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Sexual reproduction; parts of a flower (Lower Secondary)

subtopics.name: Fertilisation, seed formation and conditions for germination
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Pollination; effect of temperature on enzymes

subtopics.name: Male and female reproductive systems and gametes
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Asexual and sexual reproduction; puberty (Lower Secondary Stage 8)

subtopics.name: Fertilisation, implantation and development of the fetus; role of the placenta
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Reproductive systems; diffusion across the placenta

subtopics.name: Sex hormones and the menstrual cycle
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Reproductive systems; hormones and endocrine glands

subtopics.name: Sexually transmitted infections: HIV and its control
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Pathogens and transmission (IGCSE ch 10)

subtopics.name: Chromosomes, genes and alleles; sex inheritance
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Structure of DNA (IGCSE ch 4)

subtopics.name: Protein synthesis: genetic code, mRNA and ribosomes
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Genes and DNA; enzymes as proteins with specific shape

subtopics.name: Mitosis and meiosis: haploid and diploid nuclei
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Chromosomes; cell division in growth (IGCSE ch 2)

subtopics.name: Monohybrid inheritance: genetic diagrams, Punnett squares and test crosses
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Mitosis and meiosis; dominant and recessive alleles; ratios and probability (maths)

subtopics.name: Codominance, ABO blood groups and sex-linked characteristics
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Monohybrid inheritance and genetic diagrams

subtopics.name: Continuous and discontinuous variation; mutation as a source of new alleles
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Chromosomes and alleles; plotting histograms and bar charts (maths)

subtopics.name: Adaptive features of organisms (xerophytes and hydrophytes)
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Variation; transpiration in plants (IGCSE ch 8)

subtopics.name: Natural selection and evolution; antibiotic resistance in bacteria
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Variation; adaptive features

subtopics.name: Selective breeding
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Natural selection; monohybrid inheritance

subtopics.name: Food chains, food webs and trophic levels; pyramids of number, biomass and energy
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Photosynthesis as energy source; food chains (Lower Secondary Stage 7)

subtopics.name: Energy flow and efficiency of energy transfer between trophic levels
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Food chains and trophic levels; respiration releases energy

subtopics.name: Carbon cycle and nitrogen cycle
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Photosynthesis and respiration; role of decomposers

subtopics.name: Populations: factors affecting population size and the sigmoid growth curve
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Food webs; interpreting graphs (maths)

subtopics.name: Food supply: monocultures, intensive livestock production and use of fertilisers and pesticides
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Food chains; mineral requirements of plants (IGCSE ch 6)

subtopics.name: Habitat destruction and deforestation
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Carbon cycle; biodiversity and food webs

subtopics.name: Pollution: water pollution, eutrophication, non-biodegradable plastics and greenhouse gases
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Fertilisers; nitrogen and carbon cycles

subtopics.name: Conservation: sustainable resources, endangered species and seed banks
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Habitat destruction; human impact on biodiversity

subtopics.name: Bacteria in biotechnology; yeast in biofuels and bread making
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Anaerobic respiration in yeast; bacteria reproduce rapidly

subtopics.name: Pectinase, biological washing powders and lactase production
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Bacteria in biotechnology; enzyme action

subtopics.name: Large-scale production in fermenters (penicillin, insulin)
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Biotechnology basics; conditions for growth and enzyme activity

subtopics.name: Genetic modification: inserting human insulin gene into bacteria; GM crops and their pros and cons
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Protein synthesis and genes; fermenters
